entries.context: aḍḍhanena pathavīkasiṇādivaḍḍhaní viya kiñci payojanaṁ natthi. P
entries.note: Misprint in the printed edition (corrupted glyph). Printed reading preserved; emendation suggested from context. 2026-08-09, NOT SETTLED — THREE readings now stand. The register's applied pair is vaḍḍhaní -> vaḍḍhanī and that is what the site serves; the reader's sheet verdict reads vaḍḍhane. The pair's own warrant is weak: í (U+00ED) is a ONE-PLACE glyph, confidence 'medium', 1/1, and the register's evidence says in so many words that the reading 'follows the sense and the ê->ī pattern' — an inference, not a witness. The neighbouring codepoints do NOT support inference: é resolves two ways (ā and i) and Ù and ò are recorded as NEIGHBOURHOOD faults with mixed readings. Printed context (pdftotext, tika-unicode/25VsmT01.pdf): '…tena sattarāsivaḍḍhanena pathavīkasiṇādivaḍḍhaní viya kiñci payojanaṁ natthi'. Δ0 either way. Reader to settle; nothing applied. SETTLED BY THE READER 2026-08-09: the reading is `vaḍḍhane`.
